title: Seared Mushroom Tacos with Chipotle, Onion and Coriander
summary: Deeply browned mushrooms tossed with smoky chipotle, onion and coriander, served in warm corn tortillas for a meat-free taco night.
equipment: large heavy frying pan (30 cm), preferably cast iron
second frying pan or the same pan wiped out

ingredients.item: chipotle chilli in adobo, finely chopped (check the label: no wine vinegar)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Sear the Mushrooms
steps.text: High heat is what gives mushrooms colour, so heat 1 tbsp oil in the large frying pan until shimmering, then add half the mushrooms in a single layer. Leave them undisturbed for 3-4 minutes until deeply browned underneath, then toss and cook for a further 2-3 minutes until browned all over and any released liquid has cooked away. Tip onto a plate and repeat with another 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the mushrooms, since crowding the pan would trap steam and stop them browning.

steps.title: Cook the Onion
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium, add the final 1 tbsp oil and the sliced onion, and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and golden. Stir in the garlic, chipotle and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. A gentler heat lets the onion soften and sweeten without catching, while a brief minute with the spices wakes up their aromatic oils.

steps.title: Combine and Finish
steps.text: Once the onion is ready, return the browned mushrooms to the pan, add the salt and pepper, and toss for 1 minute until hot and glossy throughout. Stir through the chopped coriander right at the end, so it keeps its colour and fresh flavour instead of wilting in the heat.

steps.title: Warm the Tortillas
steps.text: Set an ungreased frying pan over medium-high heat, then, taking the tortillas one or two at a time, toast each side for 20-30 seconds until they're pliable, soft and marked with light speckles, ready for the chipotle mushroom filling. Wrap them in a folded clean tea towel as they come off the heat so trapped steam keeps them soft.

steps.title: Fill and Serve
steps.text: Divide the mushroom mixture among the warm tortillas and scatter with the finely chopped white onion. Serve at once with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over.

tips: Don't crowd the mushrooms in the pan — overlapping them traps steam and stops them browning, so fry in two batches as described.
Leave the mushrooms undisturbed for the first few minutes of searing; moving them too soon stops a crust forming.
Check the chipotle label for wine vinegar before buying.
Taste the mixture before adding extra salt, as the chipotle and adobo already carry some.
Add the coriander right at the end so it stays bright and doesn't turn limp in the heat.
storage: Cool quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour; use within 3 days. Reheat once until piping hot throughout (74°C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
